customer_managed_encryption_key.Description:
A reference to a KMS encryption key. If provided, it will be used to encrypt the data. If left blank, data
will be encrypted using an internal Stream-specific encryption key provisioned through KMS.

desired_state.Description: Desired state of the Stream. Set this field to 'RUNNING' to start the stream, and 'PAUSED' to pause the stream.

bigquery_destination_config.Description: A configuration for how data should be loaded to Cloud Storage.

data_freshness.Description:
The guaranteed data freshness (in seconds) when querying tables created by the stream.
Editing this field will only affect new tables created in the future, but existing tables
will not be impacted. Lower values mean that queries will return fresher data, but may result in higher cost.
A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, terminated by 's'. Example: "3.5s". Defaults to 900s.

single_target_dataset.Description: A single target dataset to which all data will be streamed.

dataset_id.Description:
Dataset ID in the format projects/{project}/datasets/{dataset_id} or
{project}:{dataset_id}

source_hierarchy_datasets.Description: Destination datasets are created so that hierarchy of the destination data objects matches the source hierarchy.

dataset_template.Description: Dataset template used for dynamic dataset creation.

dataset_id_prefix.Description:
If supplied, every created dataset will have its name prefixed by the provided value.
The prefix and name will be separated by an underscore. i.e. _.

kms_key_name.Description:
Describes the Cloud KMS encryption key that will be used to protect destination BigQuery
table. The BigQuery Service Account associated with your project requires access to this
encryption key. i.e. projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{key_ring}/cryptoKeys/{cryptoKey}.
See https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/customer-managed-encryption for more information.

location.Description:
The geographic location where the dataset should reside.
See https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/locations for supported locations.

gcs_destination_config.Description: A configuration for how data should be loaded to Cloud Storage.

file_rotation_interval.Description:
The maximum duration for which new events are added before a file is closed and a new file is created.
A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, terminated by 's'. Example: "3.5s". Defaults to 900s.

file_rotation_mb.Description: The maximum file size to be saved in the bucket.

compression.Description: Compression of the loaded JSON file. Possible values: ["NO_COMPRESSION", "GZIP"]

schema_file_format.Description: The schema file format along JSON data files. Possible values: ["NO_SCHEMA_FILE", "AVRO_SCHEMA_FILE"]

path.Description: Path inside the Cloud Storage bucket to write data to.

effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

labels.Description:
Labels.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
